summary: PR 7257 is a rebase of PR 6710 that adds SecuredByPerimeter as a publicNetworkAccess option for the document-db/database-account module. It was approved and merged.
proposed: The PR body says the original change lets networkRestrictions.publicNetworkAccess be set to SecuredByPerimeter, so Cosmos DB accounts can be secured with a Network Security Perimeter. It describes this as more granular than traditional public network access settings.
changed: The PR is a rebase that preserves the original author, poornachandugade. The slice shows a new e2e test, tests/e2e/perimeter/main.test.bicep, which pins the location to eastasia with a comment that a single-zone region is used for NSP tests. The README and CHANGELOG were updated, the latter with a 0.20.1 entry.
shipped: Commit 9f9ea1a merged the SecuredByPerimeter support, the 0.20.1 CHANGELOG entry, the README changes and the perimeter e2e test under avm/res/document-db/database-account.
